title: Sippikkul Muthu
desc: Sivayya, a person with autism, lives in a village with his grandmother. Things take a turn when he marries a widow, Lalitha, in order to save her from the atrocities of widowhood.

title: Alli Arjuna
desc: Neglected by his wealthy parents, Arivu grows up to be a troublesome man. Later, when a young woman seeks refuge from him, he falls in love with her, only to discover a dark truth from the past.

title: Kizhakku Vaasal
desc: When an influential man from the village tries to molest Thaayamma, an orphan, she escapes from his clutches and is saved by Ponnurangam. Eventually, they fall in love.

title: Looty
desc: Childless couple Rasappa and Geetha adopt the child abandoned in their car. However, problems ensue when Geetha suspects her husband to be the biological father of the child.

title: Ayan
desc: Deva, a computer science student, works with a smuggler against his mother's wishes. His life unravels when his closest friend is murdered, leading him to help the police catch a powerful drug lord.
